_comment: xol-ernie - ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Preview (280B latent MoE, ~14B active) on Xolotl's ernie_generate (docs/ERNIE.md, preview).
Any GGUF in the llama.cpp PR #31925 layout. The tokenizer pack comes from the same GGUF:
routes.bin is the routing profile: --rank-counts seeds the VRAM cache and the RAM arena hottest-first at the start,
--count-routes adds every request's routing to the same file, so the next start seeds from what you actually use.
--slots 2300 --prefill-chunk 256: a fixed 2,300-expert VRAM cache leaves room for 256-token prompt passes (measured 115-120 tok/s served prefill; 512 still fails at ~25K context).
--arena-gib: the RAM the routed experts may use; set it to what the machine can spare.
--kv-mla q8_0 / q4_0 halves / quarters the long-context KV (q4_0 Hadamard-rotated); f16 is the reference.
